title: Famine Strachey Commission (1880)
definition: The first Famine Commission appointed by the British Government in 1880 under the chairmanship of Sir Richard Strachey to formulate a systematic policy for famine prevention and relief in British India.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the transition from 'ad-hoc' relief measures to a 'codified' administrative framework, reflecting the colonial state's evolving approach to agrarian distress and state responsibility.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Famine Stratchy Commission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
